title: Repo Note
description: repo-note/v1 — the document default-notice, default-revocation, closeout-default and termination carry. All four are decided from the log by the guards (who emits, what is outstanding); the document is a free-text reason for the audit trail. trade-blocked (stage 6.5) carries the reason and the step a router could not take.

step.description: On trade-blocked: the step the router could not take (the reactor's step name).
